final: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), b AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS base FROM t), k AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t, b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND t.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS km FROM k), r AS (SELECT k.a FROM k, m WHERE k.a > m.km) SELECT AVG(r.a) AS avg_type_price, AVG(r.a - b.base) AS above_baseline, AVG(r.a - m.km) AS above_kept_mean FROM r, b, m HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
